summary: Completed security bug testing and hard delete feature verification for Iteration 8. All security features working correctly: 1) Token validation via /api/auth/me as single source of truth, 2) Invalid/missing tokens return 401/403, 3) ESCI button visible and functional, 4) Hard delete with soft-delete + anonymization working, 5) Cannot delete self, 6) Cannot delete last admin, 7) Only ADMIN level 10 can hard delete.
passed_tests: SECURITY: GET /api/auth/me without token returns 401/403 (unauthorized)
SECURITY: GET /api/auth/me with invalid token returns 401
SECURITY: GET /api/auth/me with expired/malformed token returns 401
SECURITY: Login with valid credentials returns token and user data
SECURITY: GET /api/auth/me with valid token returns user data
SECURITY: Opening site without token shows guest view (city page with ACCEDI button)
SECURITY: After localStorage.clear() shows guest view
DELETE /api/users/{id}/hard-delete without DELETE confirmation returns 400
DELETE /api/users/{id}/hard-delete with empty confirmation returns 400
DELETE /api/users/{id}/hard-delete cannot delete self (returns 403)
DELETE /api/users/{id}/hard-delete requires ADMIN level 10 (returns 403 for lower levels)
DELETE /api/users/{id}/hard-delete for non-existent user returns 404
DELETE /api/users/{id}/hard-delete with DELETE confirmation performs soft-delete + anonymization
Hard delete anonymizes email to deleted_uuid@purelife.rp and game_name to DELETED
PUT /api/chat/presence updates presence to online after login
GET /api/chat/presence/me returns current presence status
POST /api/auth/logout endpoint exists (frontend handles logout via localStorage.clear)
UI: ESCI button visible in header after login (data-testid=logout-btn)
UI: ESCI button performs logout and redirects to /login
UI: Token cleared from localStorage after logout
UI: Presence status shows ONLINE with green indicator after login
UI: /admin/users page shows 12 users with delete button (red trash) for each user
UI: User table shows all columns (Utente, Settore, Grado, Livello, Capo, Stato, Ultimo Accesso, Azioni)
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.validateAndFetchUser() correctly uses /api/auth/me as single source of truth
clearAuthStorage() properly removes plos_token, plos_refresh_token, and plos_user from localStorage
forceLogout() redirects to /login when token is invalid
Hard delete endpoint correctly implements soft-delete with anonymization
Audit log created with action USER_DELETE_HARD including original user data
Last admin protection working (checks active, non-deleted admins count)
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_security_and_hard_delete.py - Created comprehensive test suite for security and hard delete
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted test users (TEST_admin2, TEST_admin3, TEST_delete_*) during testing - all cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: All security features from iteration 8 verified: 1) Token validation via /api/auth/me working as single source of truth, 2) Guest view shown when no valid token, 3) ESCI button visible and functional (logout + redirect to /login), 4) Hard delete with soft-delete + anonymization working correctly, 5) Cannot delete self, 6) Cannot delete last admin, 7) Only ADMIN level 10 can perform hard delete. The presence status correctly shows ONLINE after login with green indicator.

token_validation.description: /api/auth/me used as single source of truth for user authentication
token_validation.behavior: Returns 401/403 for invalid/missing tokens, returns user data for valid tokens

guest_view.description: Without valid token, user sees guest view (city page with ACCEDI button)
guest_view.behavior: No user information displayed, localStorage cleared

logout_button.description: ESCI button visible in header after login

hard_delete.description: Soft-delete with anonymization for user accounts
hard_delete.behavior: Requires DELETE confirmation, anonymizes email/game_name, creates audit log

self_delete_protection.description: Admin cannot delete their own account
self_delete_protection.behavior: Returns 403 with message 'Non puoi eliminare il tuo stesso account'

last_admin_protection.description: Cannot delete the last admin in the system
last_admin_protection.behavior: Returns 403 with message 'Impossibile eliminare l'ultimo admin del sistema'

hierarchy_protection.description: Only ADMIN level 10 can perform hard delete
